name: Math — Needs & Wants (Financial Literacy)
subject: Mathematics
desc: Financial literacy lesson exploring needs vs. wants, budgeting decisions, and how personal choices affect spending. Aligned to Ontario Math curriculum.

name: Science — Inquiry Investigation
subject: Science & Technology
desc: Structured inquiry lesson using the scientific method. Students form a hypothesis, design a fair test, collect data, and draw conclusions. Adaptable to any science unit.

name: Language Arts — Reading Response
subject: Language Arts
desc: Reading comprehension lesson using a mentor text. Students apply inferencing strategies and respond in writing using text evidence.

name: Social Studies — Community Roles
subject: Social Studies
desc: Community helpers and civic responsibility lesson. Students explore roles in their community, why communities need different helpers, and what it means to belong.
